title: Without Anvil: a tempted agent books business class
description: An agent is tempted by business class. With enforcement off, nothing checks it and the money is gone.

title: With Anvil: blocked, explained, self-corrected
description: The same business-class booking, with Anvil on: blocked, the reason handed back, the agent corrects itself, the new booking is verified.

title: A clean trip, planned by the Gemini agent
description: Natural-language request, A2A discovery, Gemini picks offers, every booking audited and verified.

title: Cheaper but weaker than policy: escalated to a person
description: Non-refundable options are not forbidden, so Anvil escalates them for a one-tap human decision.

title: Splitting a fare to slip under a limit
description: Total is under the cap and the supplier is approved, so a rules check passes it. Anvil sees the structuring.

title: A fake 'manager pre-approved' note
description: Free text cannot authorize anything. The over-cap fare is still escalated to the manager.
